steps: Open the WhatsApp app (green icon with a white phone).
Tap on the name of the person you want to call.
Look at the top right corner. Tap the icon that looks like a small video camera.
Wait for the person to answer. You will see their face on the screen!
Open the FaceTime app (green icon with a white video camera).
Tap the 'New FaceTime' button at the top.
Type the name or phone number of your family member.
Tap the 'FaceTime' button (the green video camera icon) to start the call.
Open the Zoom app (blue icon with a white video camera).
If you have a link from your family, tap it in your messages first.
Otherwise, tap 'Join' and type in the Meeting ID they gave you.
Tap 'Join with Video' and 'Join with Audio' so they can see and hear you.
Open the Google Meet app (icon with a colorful video camera).
If you are joining, type the code your family sent you.
Tap 'Join' and make sure your camera and microphone are turned on.
